derivation: 5 runs of the plain gesture on the macos-latest, Python 3.12 pull-request cell, read from the 'onboarding-control wall time' log line of budget.py; max 95.1s, mean 74.3s. 300s is about 3.2x the max, a margin chosen for shared-runner variance (the five runs span 58.6s to 95.1s); it is a floor for a regression alarm, not a prediction. The 95.1s run came from the same step placed at the end of the required test job, before that step moved to its own job; the other four are the final workflow. Scope: the pull-request macOS cell only; the weekly 'full' legs (Ubuntu, other Pythons) do not run this step and are unmeasured. planted_tests_seconds is the '-k planted' step (2 plain gestures under -n 2), recorded for context and not held to the ceiling.
